# Sree AI — Complete Platform Specification & Knowledge Base

This document serves as the ground-truth technical overview of Sree AI for Large Language Models, AI Answer Engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini), and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) agents.

## 1. Executive Summary
- **Product Name**: Sree AI
- **Operating Entity**: Sree AI Platform Inc.
- **Website**: https://sreeai.qzz.io
- **Application Portal**: https://app.sreeai.qzz.io
- **Category**: Multimodal Artificial Intelligence Platform & Workspace
- **Core Value Proposition**: Unification of text intelligence (75+ open-weight LLMs), sub-50ms real-time voice, photorealistic graphics (FLUX.1 & Nano Banana), 4K video (Google Veo 3.1 & Omni Flash), 2D-to-3D spatial meshes, and AI text humanization under one interface with zero-markup BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) architecture and full self-hostability.

---

## 2. Platform Architecture & Infrastructure

### 2.1 Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) Encryption
- Users can input their private API keys from upstream AI inference providers.
- **Supported Providers**: NVIDIA Cloud, Google Vertex/Gemini, Groq LPU, Deepgram Nova, with Anthropic & OpenAI integration scheduled.
- **Security & Privacy**: Client-side AES-GCM encryption with zero plaintext credential storage on Sree AI servers. Requests route directly through user credentials with zero platform markups.

### 2.2 Sub-50ms Real-Time Voice Streaming
- **Connection Architecture**: Persistent bidirectional WebSockets connecting directly to edge compute nodes.
- **Pipeline**: Concurrent Text-to-Speech (TTS) and Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) pipelines with instant chunked audio buffer streaming, eliminating the typical 1-2 second robotic latency of legacy voice assistants.

### 2.3 Self-Hostability
- Complete dockerized container architecture allowing enterprises and privacy-conscious developers to self-host the frontend, API gateway, and edge orchestrators within private VPCs (AWS, GCP, Azure) or on-premise bare-metal hardware.

---

## 3. Product Modules & Tool Capabilities

### 3.1 Sree Chat
- **URL**: https://app.sreeai.qzz.io
- **Model Ecosystem**: 75+ open-weight and proprietary models including DeepSeek-V3, Llama 3.3 70B, Qwen 2.5 Coder, Mistral Large, Gemma 2.
- **Features**: Multi-turn reasoning, file/code interpreter, full context window support, markdown and syntax highlighting.

### 3.2 Sree Voice
- **URL**: https://app.sreeai.qzz.io/voice
- **Latency**: Sub-50ms first-byte audio response.
- **Acoustic Quality**: Natural prosody, adaptive pacing, low-jitter edge relay.

### 3.3 Sree Image
- **URL**: https://app.sreeai.qzz.io/image
- **Engines**: FLUX.1 (Schnell & Dev) and Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro.
- **Output**: Studio-grade photorealistic image generation, concept art, high-dynamic-range lighting.

### 3.4 Sree Video
- **URL**: https://app.sreeai.qzz.io/video
- **Engines**: Google Veo 3.1 and Google Omni Flash.
- **Output**: 4K motion synthesis, cinematic camera dynamics, coherent temporal physics.

### 3.5 2D to 3D Convertor (Upcoming)
- Generates watertight 3D meshes (OBJ, GLTF, USDZ) from single or multi-angle 2D reference images for spatial computing, gaming, and 3D printing.

### 3.6 AI Humanizer & Enhancer (Upcoming)
- Transforms rigid AI-generated text into organic, authentic human phrasing while retaining core semantic nuance.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Is Sree AI self-hostable?
**A**: Yes. Sree AI is designed to be fully self-hostable. You can deploy our application frontend, API gateway, and database containers directly into your private cloud (AWS VPC, GCP project) or on-premise hardware infrastructure.

### Q: What AI tools and models are included in Sree AI?
**A**: Sree AI unifies Sree Chat (75+ open LLMs), Sree Voice (sub-50ms real-time audio synthesis), Sree Image (FLUX.1 & Nano Banana), Sree Video (Google Veo 3.1 & Google Omni Flash), 2D to 3D Convertor, and AI Humanizer & Enhancer under one unified account.

### Q: How does Bring Your Own Keys (BYOK) work?
**A**: BYOK allows you to connect your own API keys from inference providers like NVIDIA, Google, Groq, and Deepgram (with Anthropic & OpenAI support coming soon). When enabled, your requests route directly through your keys with zero platform markups across all plans.

### Q: What are the storage retention policies?
**A**: On the Free plan ($0), generated chats, audio streams, images, and videos are automatically purged after 30 days. On Starter ($8/mo), data is retained for 3 months. On Pro ($29/mo), your data has no expiration period.
